name: paper-orchestra
description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
one_liner: A team of AI agents that work together to research a topic and write an academic-style paper about it automatically.
buyer: A PhD student or academic lab under publication pressure who needs help drafting papers faster, though they must still verify every claim themselves.
business_use_cases: A research lab uses it to generate a first full draft of a paper from raw experimental results and notes, then has a human revise and verify it.
A grad student turns months of lab notes into a structured paper skeleton before spending their own time on polish and accuracy.
An ed-tech company builds a paid 'thesis draft assistant' for grad students on top of it, with heavy disclaimers about verifying content.

money_ideas.idea: Build a paid SaaS wrapper for grad students and labs that turns raw notes and data into a first paper draft, billed per draft generated

steal_this: Wrap it in a simple upload-your-notes-and-data interface, charge per generated draft, and market directly to grad students stressed about deadlines — with a clear 'verify everything' disclaimer.
